title: Commission + quota bonus + clawback with returns
text: A salesperson sells 72 units in Phase 1 and 59 units in Phase 2. Unit price is 326.59 then 355.05. Commission is 1.03% but becomes 5.53% for units sold beyond quota 79 (counting units across both phases). Phase-2 returns are 14 units; if returns exceed 53 units, a clawback of 29.39% of Phase-1 commission applies. Taxes are 12.06% applied after the higher-rate quota bonus is accounted for, but before clawback. Compute final take-home pay (commission after tax and any clawback).
